decisions.rationale: It needs real native processes and the real filesystem in a trusted dedicated workspace.

why_not.virtual: virtual uses emulated bash and does not spawn native processes.
why_not.remote: remote could work but adds provider cost and lifecycle ownership not needed for this trusted case.

risk_controls: run only in a dedicated trusted VM or container
do not pass all environment variables

decisions.rationale: The task needs isolation and ephemeral files, not native processes.

why_not.local: local has no isolation and would expose the host to untrusted tenant input.
why_not.remote: remote is an upgrade path if a full provider workspace is required.

decisions.rationale: It needs a durable provider workspace keyed by conversation or issue.

why_not.local: local shares host state and is hard to govern per issue.
why_not.virtual: virtual is ephemeral and cannot provide a durable Linux workspace.
